newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Euro Presidency to meet new French govt.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Euro Presidency to meet new French govt.

text.p: Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo will visit Paris and Athens next week as part of a tour of European capitals before a European Union summit in Amsterdam on June 16-17.
The Dutch government said on Friday the pair would travel to Athens on June 9 for talks with Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis and Foreign Minister Theodoros Pangalos.
They will move to Paris on June 10 to meet French President Jacques Chirac and new Foreign Minister Hubert Vedrine, before holding separate talks with Prime Minister Lionel Jospin.
The Netherlands holds the EU presidency until the end of June. Leaders of the 15-nation bloc are due to sign a treaty on reform of EU institutions at the Amsterdam summit.
